name: Autumn Campfire
description: The colors of a late October campfire at dusk — embers, ash, smoke, and the last stubborn leaves

palette.name: Ember Core
palette.note: the hottest part of the fire, almost too bright to look at

palette.name: Flame Orange
palette.note: dancing at the tips where oxygen meets fuel

palette.name: Burnt Sienna
palette.note: the glowing coals settling in for the long burn

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.note: next morning's aftermath, still faintly warm

palette.name: Smoke Drift
palette.note: the plume heading wherever the wind decides

palette.name: Pine Dusk
palette.note: the dark tree line silhouette at golden hour

palette.name: Dried Leaf
palette.note: october leaf, papery and curling at the edges

palette.name: Twilight Sky
palette.note: the sky above when you've stayed just a bit too late
